Als Senior\-Entwickler:in gestaltest Du bei uns Produkt und Kundenbeziehungen aktiv mit und bist in Trägerschaft für wichtige Prozesse wie Projekte. Konkret heißt das:

  

* Du entwickelst Frontend\- und Backend\-Komponenten von TIMEOFFICE weiter und übernimmst Verantwortung über den eigenen Code hinaus.

  

* Du entwirfst Architekturen, Schnittstellen und technische Konzepte und setzt sie auch um.

* Du gestaltest unsere technologische Ausrichtung, Toolchains und Entwicklungsprozesse aktiv mit.

  

* Du arbeitest eng und kollegial mit Kolleg:innen aus anderen Disziplinen zusammen und stehst im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kund:innen.

  

* Du befähigst Kolleg:innen durch Deine Expertise, teilst Dein Wissen und unterstützt andere in ihrer professionellen Entwicklung.

  

Unser gemeinsames Ziel: Wirksamkeit und Arbeitsfreude in Kliniken, Feuerwehren und anderen Kundenorganisationen stärken – und dabei selbst mit viel Freude und hohem Eigenanspruch arbeiten.

 **WAS WIR UNS VON DIR WÜNSCHEN...**

  

* Du bist erfahrene:r Full\-Stack\-Entwickler:in mit ausgeprägtem Allrounder\-Profil. Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstorganisiert und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch – und weißt zugleich, wie man pragmatisch Strecke macht.
* Im Frontend setzen wir Vue.js und TypeScript ein. Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit modernen SPA\-Frameworks mit – vergleichbare Praxis mit React oder Angular ist ebenso relevant.
* Im Backend verfügst Du über tiefe Praxis mit ASP.NET Core Web APIs und Microsoft SQL Server oder PostgreSQL. REST\-basierte Architekturen, saubere API\-Schnitte sowie ein solides Verständnis für Datenmodelle und Performance sind für Dich selbstverständlich.
* Teile unserer Cloud\-Services betreiben wir in Azure. Du hast idealerweise produktive Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure und verstehst Cloud\-Infrastruktur im Allgemeinen. Nicht nur als Deployment\-Ziel, sondern, im Sinne von DevOps, als Teil der Architektur, die Du mit gestaltest und betreibst.

* Boilerplate\-Code lässt Du gerne von AI erledigen, z.B. von GitHub Copilot oder Claude Code – mit klarem Blick auf Codequalität, Wartbarkeit und Verantwortung.
* Du kommunizierst offen und zugewandt, gibst konstruktiven Rat und forderst aktiv Hilfe ein, wenn es mal schwierig wird.
* Stillstand ist nichts für Dich. Du hast Lust auf Neues – in Technologien, fachlichen Domänen und Denkweisen.

 **Dein Fundament:**

* **Dein Background:** Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Informatik oder vergleichbar) in der Tasche.
* **Dein Track\-Record:** Du blickst auf mindestens 4 Jahre echte Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung zurück.
* **Deine Base:** Da wir eng im Team und direkt mit unseren Kunden zusammenarbeiten, kommunizierst Du sicher und fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch.
* **Deine Location:** Du wohnst in der Nähe von Bochum oder bist umzugsbereit, denn Präsenz an mindestens 3 Tagen pro Woche bei uns im Büro ist für unser Miteinander essenziell.

**Dein Tech\-Stack \& Mindset:**

* **Full\-Stack aus Überzeugung:** Du bewegst dich im gesamten Stack sicher und bringst ein tiefes analytisches Denken mit.
* **Architektur \& Konzepte:** RESTful APIs, relationale Datenbanken und gängige Design Patterns sind Dein tägliches Handwerkszeug. Dein klarer Fokus liegt auf zukunftsfähiger Software\-Architektur.

jobs.description:
#### **Role Summary and Department Overview**

Peel Hunt is looking for an enthusiastic IT Developer with strong core Java skills, an interest in learning other technologies and a desire to work across a diverse business and technology stack.


The role sits within an experienced Development team of six and will work on a range of in\-house systems supporting real\-time equity trading, electronic market making, business workflow management and internal data analysis. The team is highly visible and delivers functionality across the firm.


The Development team has responsibility for its own working practices and operates a flat structure, with shared decision\-making and accountability. The role reports to the Head of Development and works closely with TechOps, Tech Programme Management, Data Technology and Analytics, and Systems across the wider IT department.

##### **Core Technology Environment**

* Java 25 server\-side applications, supported by Python for simpler scripts.
* React web applications, SQL Server databases and C\# native front ends.
* KDB time\-series storage and analysis.
* Informatica UltraMessaging and Chronicle\-based infrastructure.
* Influx and Grafana for system instrumentation and monitoring.
* Linux servers, including RHEL 9\.
* Development tools including IntelliJ, Rider, Git, JIRA/YouTrack and TeamCity.
* Experimental use of Claude Code.

#### **Responsibilities**

###### **Role Responsibilities:**

* Develop and deliver software solutions addressing a wide range of business problems.
* Work with stakeholders to understand their requirements and the wider problem, and determine the most appropriate solution.
* Ability to work both independently as well as collaboratively with other developers, depending on the scope and scale of the project.
* Plan and organise projects to deliver within appropriate timescales, adapting where priorities or relevant factors change.
* Ask for help when needed and support colleagues to ensure the team's outputs are functionally complete, performant and supportable.
* Work across greenfield development, extensions to existing applications, and day\-to\-day maintenance and enhancements.
* Provide second\-line support for the Development team's systems.

###### **Key Capabilities and Knowledge:**

* At least three years' server\-side development experience using core Java.
* Experience of high\-performance, distributed and multi\-threaded systems.
* Understanding of interfaces between, and separation of, interconnected modules and systems.
* Experience of front\-to\-back involvement in software development and delivery.
* Ability to break down complex problems into manageable phases.
* Commitment to delivering high\-quality code that minimises long\-term support and maintenance requirements.
* Experience of automated, unit and functional testing, with a pragmatic approach to the appropriate level of testing.
* Working knowledge of Linux.
* Ideally a 2:1 degree or higher in a technical discipline.

###### **Desirable experience:**

* React, which is a key technology for the team.
* SQL databases and queries, including Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle or Sybase.
* C\# GUI development.
* Python scripting or programming, potentially using libraries such as SciPy.
* KDB querying, management or maintenance.
* Chronicle, Influx or Grafana.
* Financial services experience is not essential. Strong technical capability, creativity and a desire to learn are valued more highly.

###### **Role Competencies:**

* Enthusiastic, curious and keen to learn new technologies and business areas.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Able to communicate effectively with technical colleagues and business stakeholders.
* Collaborative and willing both to learn from others and share knowledge.
* Organised, accountable and able to manage changing priorities.
* Pragmatic, with sound judgement about quality, performance, testing and supportability.
* Comfortable taking responsibility within a flat team structure.

###### **Other:**


This role is subject to the FCA Conduct Rules and the successful candidate will be required to comply with the standards of conduct expected under the Senior Managers and Certification Regime (SMCR).


We work on a hybrid basis, with three days a week in the office, while recognising the need for flexibility and balancing this with the requirements of the business.

##### **Line Management Responsibilities**


The role has no direct line management responsibilities. The role holder is expected to support colleagues, share knowledge and contribute to collective decision\-making within the Development team.

Over the past 30 years, we’ve grown from humble beginnings with a single computer into a diversified, global, technology\-enabled lottery and prize draw company (ASX: JIN). Today, Jumbo operates across Australia, the UK, Canada and the US, bringing together technology, creativity and purpose to create premium digital experiences people love.


Based in Galgate, StarVale is dedicated to strengthening the fundraising power of charities, not‑for‑profits, and hospices across the UK. We combine specialist lottery management with a genuine commitment to helping organisations maximise their impact, so more communities receive the support they deserve.

**What will you be doing?**


We’re looking for a .NET Web Developer to join us in this hands‑on build‑and‑migrate role. You will be rewriting existing PHP websites in .NET, integrating them with our business systems, and helping shape how we structure our shared architecture going forward. Working closely with cross‑functional teams, you will support day‑to‑day business needs, solve complex technical challenges, and contribute to high‑quality engineering practices through code reviews, documentation, and collaborative solution design.

**What Your Day\-to\-Day Will Look Like**


Your daily work will centre on maintaining, modernising, and progressively transforming our legacy .NET systems while supporting the smooth running of core business operations across StarVale. You can expect to:

* Design and build ASP.NET Core websites targeting modern .NET versions (including .NET 10\)
* Migrate Laravel and CodeIgniter sites to the .NET platform while preserving functionality, SEO, and data integrity
* Work with Umbraco CMS — extending existing implementations or building new sites where appropriate
* Integrate websites with core .NET business systems and SQL Server databases
* Write and maintain EF Core data access code, including migrating data from MySQL to SQL Server
* Document business logic and edge cases from existing PHP sites before decommissioning
* Contribute to shared architecture decisions, internal libraries, and coding standards
* Write clean, tested, maintainable code and participate in code reviews

**What You’ll Be Able to Bring to the Role**

**Essential**

* Solid commercial experience with C\# and ASP.NET Core (or strong ASP.NET MVC experience with a clear path to Core)
* Experience with Entity Framework Core (or EF) and relational databases (SQL Server)
* Comfortable working with front\-end fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) alongside server\-rendered .NET views or Razor Pages
* Experience migrating or integrating systems between different platforms or frameworks
* Ability to read and understand PHP (Laravel and/or CodeIgniter) well enough to translate existing functionality into .NET — you won't be writing new PHP, but you'll need to understand what's there
* Good understanding of web fundamentals: routing, authentication, forms, SEO basics (URL structure, redirects)

**Mindset \& Soft Skills**

* Migration Mindset: Confidence to evaluate legacy code, challenge outdated practices, and guide non\-technical stakeholders through modernized technical solutions.
* Problem Solver: Highly resourceful with strong initiative, able to own projects independently from requirements\-gathering to deployment.
* Communication: Excellent people skills to liaise effectively between technical teams, external auditors, and cross\-departmental stakeholders.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with Umbraco CMS
* Experience with Blazor
* Familiarity with Azure or other cloud hosting for .NET applications
* Experience leading or contributing to a platform migration or legacy system modernization
* Understanding of REST API design, for connecting websites to internal business systems
* Ability to work within agile environments, including Kanban and Sprints.

**Salary Banding: £35,000–£45,000 per annum, depending on experience.**

 **Our Ways of Working**


At StarVale, we value balance and flexibility. You will be based in our office in Galgate, Lancaster. This role is a flexible hybrid, typically averaging 50% in the office (2\-3 days per week). We prioritise results and collaborate to make sure everyone can contribute effectively, while enjoying flexibility and balance in how they work.

**Why Join StarVale?**

At StarVale, our team thrives because we invest in our people. Here’s what you can expect from us;

* An annual regional bonus scheme that rewards your contributions, dependent on company performance.
* 25 days annual leave \+ public holidays \+ your birthday off.
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program, providing counselling and coaching.

The AI Hub is a new function within People \& Technology, created to help CatalystOne identify, prioritise and realise the value of AI across the business.


We don't see AI as purely a technology topic. Introducing AI changes how work is organised, what people need to learn, and where human judgement matters most. We want those conversations considered together, close to the people doing the work.


The purpose of the AI Hub is to bring together process improvement, organisational change and technology to help teams work better and deliver stronger outcomes. As our AI Operations Engineer, you'll play a key role in turning ideas into solutions that people use every day.

Your users are your colleagues.

You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager to assess opportunities and agree scope. The AI Business Partner leads process improvement, adoption and value measurement. * An AI support agent that resolves around a fifth of internal IT tickets before they reach the IT team.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are

At EY, you’ll have the opportunity to build a career as unique as you, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better.

Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

Within Technology Consulting Financial Services, we help leading banks, insurance companies and other financial institutions navigate complex technology transformations. By combining deep industry knowledge with innovative technologies, we support our clients in building scalable, secure and future-ready solutions.

The opportunity

As a Developer, you will join multidisciplinary teams delivering technology solutions for leading financial institutions. You will be involved in the full software development lifecycle, contributing to the design, development, testing and deployment of applications that support critical business operations.

You will work alongside business analysts, architects, project managers and client stakeholders, leveraging modern technologies and agile methodologies to deliver high-quality solutions in a dynamic and international environment.

Your Key Responsibilities

Software Development
Design, develop and maintain scalable and high-performance applications.
Develop backend and/or frontend components following best development practices.
Produce clean, efficient and reusable code.
Support application integration activities across multiple systems and platforms.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

Testing & Quality Assurance
Develop and execute unit and integration tests.
Support defect analysis, troubleshooting and bug fixing activities.
Ensure compliance with quality, security and performance standards.
Contribute to the implementation of DevOps and CI/CD practices.

Collaboration & Delivery
Work closely with business and technical teams to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives.
Support solution deployment and post-implementation activities.
Contribute to project documentation and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Passion for technology and software development.
Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Proactive mindset with a willingness to learn and adapt.
Attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related field.
1-5 years of professional experience in software development (depending on seniority level).
Experience with one or more programming languages such as Java, C#, .NET, Python, JavaScript or TypeScript.
Knowledge of modern software development methodologies and Agile frameworks.
Fluency in Portuguese and English.

What We Look For

We’re interested in highly motivated professionals who are passionate about technology and innovation. You should be a team player with a strong desire to learn, solve complex problems and help clients achieve their business objectives through technology.

If you’re ready to take on a wide range of responsibilities and are committed to seeking out new ways to make a difference, this role is for you.

What We Offer

EY offers a competitive remuneration package commensurate with your work experience. Plus, we offer:

Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around;
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career;- The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you.

EY | Shape the future with confidence.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

At EY, we're committed to providing recruitment and career opportunities to all, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, social background or disability. We believe that equality and diversity are central to our recruitment process, as they enhance creativity and efficiency, leading to improved performance and productivity. In line with this commitment, EY Portugal recently became a member of the Inclusive Community Forum. This initiative, led by Nova SBE, focuses on the recruitment of individuals with disabilities, advocating for a more inclusive community. Moreover, EY Portugal has also endorsed the Diversity Charter of APPDI (the Portuguese Association for Diversity and Inclusion), pledging to establish and develop internal policies and practices which support diversity. Through these initiatives, EY seeks to actively contribute to the inclusion process, and promote a more inclusive community for people with disabilities, by actively participating in creating solutions.

Join us in building a better working world. Apply now!
